original_card.question: Can a changed G20 helper path or independent-target split improve the complete BIT moment without losing its physical endpoint?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read revision 8, the selected review and live exact-source handoffs. Then follow this card's bounded first_experiment.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only, not a supplier replay or theorem proof.

original_card.first_experiment: First read #5679/#5708 and their audits as pending component proposals. Choose one uncovered helper group/cut on an exact word; compare arbitrary-input native action, targets, owned storage, both orientations and full signed bill. Stop if the gain is only a scalar count or repaid by lost targets. Do not rerun the frozen #5609 common-frame domain without changing its hypothesis.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.
allowed_variations: One exact source head, helper/cut region or quantified proposition and changed hypothesis; check live handoffs first. Different seeds are not different scopes.
scope_change_triggers: Changing source head, helper/cut domain, operation alphabet or caller boundary without recording the new scope.
Treating an archived proposal or local numerical pass as complete supplier admission.

existing_checks.scope: Selected PR5599: complete helper-subspace construction and independent caller replay; five framework assumptions remain.
existing_checks.remaining: The next experiment must identify uncovered source-specific work. Successor archive intake does not transfer this admission.

actual_scope: Exact census of dynamic owned-helper captures (atlas PR5586 B1) on the final PR5708 G20 local word: every retained helper with an arbitrary injected payload at every dead/live epoch boundary; the five helper pairs whose joint ownership lengthens a dead interval; every helper pair under the individual schedule; and a joint parity-token bound for owned sets of any size. Positive control on the PR5667 word.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one uncovered changed helper path. PR5586 B1 and the open questions of PR5604/PR5671 point to multi-epoch and joint dynamic captures as the uncovered class; before choosing an instance this package checks the whole class on the exact word.
bottleneck_link: The ordinary BIT target B* = 0.0037 needs +40.95 of signed moment over the PR5708 invoice, i.e. +2.28 per local word across 18 calls; each owned full helper debits 8^t = 7.94. The census shows how much of that a capture can repay on this word.
stop_rule: Stop when single helpers, all epochs, joint-dead pairs and all helper pairs are decided exactly, the control rediscovers the nine PR5671 cuts, and the receipt is reproduced; leave larger joint sets as an explicit open question with the bound that remains.
author: Matarener
ai_assistance: Substantial Anthropic Claude assistance (Claude Code) for the implementation and calculations. No package code imported; no independent human acceptance claimed.

open_questions.question: Does any owned set of three or more helpers pay its targets on the PR5708 word (complete joint search)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the only part of the single-word B1 capture class left open here. The joint parity-token bound closes every set except those built mainly from the helpers with a free rank-2 own query; reaching 0.0037 would need at least the number of such helpers stated in RESULT.json joint_bound, all compatible.
open_questions.first_step: Restrict to helpers with a free rank-2 own query and their shared queries (RESULT.json joint_bound). Encode each candidate injection as an F2 vector of parity bits plus exact matrix-level equalities, and solve the weighted maximum consistent subset as an ILP or SAT/MaxSAT instance with the gain inequality as objective; verify any positive witness with capture.py exact replay.
open_questions.blocked_by: A new exact solver encoding (hours of compute); no new mathematics needed.

open_questions.question: Do changed words (new producers, paid frame conversions, address-dependent recoding) create helpers with more than one live interval or larger shared queries?
open_questions.why_it_matters: On this word every helper has exactly one live interval, so the multi-epoch premise of B1 has no instance; B1 needs a changed producer.
open_questions.first_step: Run capture.py analyze_sets on any new G20 successor word; a second live interval or a single-helper bound above zero is the signal.
